cases.name: Carolyn Page Karsner Barker
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was retired from the Kentucky Supreme Court Clerks Office. She was a member of Highland Christian Church, The Order of Eastern Star Hiram Lodge #93, and Ladies Auxiliary VFW Post #4075. She was an avid reader and appreciated the natural beauty of Kentucky scenery. She loved and cherished her family dearly."
